articles.title: How to make a mandi settlement slip
articles.summary: Make a mandi settlement slip (hisab), weighment slip and buyer bill: gross, tare, net weight, rate, commission, market fee, advance and the balance to pay.

articles.title: Farmer and buyer accounts
articles.summary: See what you owe each farmer and what each buyer owes you, send a WhatsApp reminder, pay and receive in the App and download an Excel file of all slips.
